annotations.title: Find the right LLPRO tool for a job

description: Search all LLPRO tools (about 250: facts, web pages, documents, finance, compliance, trust and records) by what you want done, in plain words. Returns up to 10 matching tools: name, what it does, its input fields and an example call. Free, no sign-up, nothing stored. Example: {"query": "check a vendor invoice for duplicates"}

query.description: The job in a few plain words, e.g. 'late fee on an invoice' or 'is this VAT number valid'.
